title: Touchscreen usability and screen cleanliness
summary: Reviews about the G60 touchscreen focus mainly on difficult menu navigation and climate-control reliance on the screen, with some positive feedback on screen size and operation but several mentions that the surface quickly shows fingerprints and smudges.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the touchscreen for working well and having a satisfying screen size, though one example notes it takes time to get used to.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the touchscreen as clumsy, overly complicated, menu-heavy, hard to navigate, and prone to fingerprints and smudges that require frequent cleaning.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the screen-based climate controls are difficult to get used to and are less preferred than physical buttons.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the touchscreen or in-car technology without enough detail to tell whether the experience was favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: The examples are sentiment-stratified and not a random sample, so they do not indicate how common any issue is in the broader population.
Several selected fragments are very short or truncated, which limits detail on the exact touchscreen problem in those cases.
Some positive and undetermined examples overlap around needing time to get used to the touchscreen, making the adaptation experience only partially clear from the sample.
